facts.fact: SARB governor Kganyago said on 1 September 2026 that the National Payment System Bill, moving payment regulation from an entity-based to an activity-based model, will soon go out for public comment, following an authorisation framework.

An MTN Group Fintech executive said South Africa has no dedicated non-bank mobile money licence, so fintechs must partner with a licensed bank to move money; the SARB is working on an equivalent through the authorisation framework and the Bill.
